# jadix_winit_appkit maintained source

Upstream package: `winit-appkit` `0.31.0-beta.3`.
Source: `git+https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit.git?rev=758a50e35a928dbf72bf05ae91f12fee7a540a83#758a50e35a928dbf72bf05ae91f12fee7a540a83`.
Base manifest SHA-256: `d61e06a739b6d9b08048768241dc03abaeb5a76162ee93d6680f1c8cdfaee26f`.

The package is renamed for the Jadix release dependency closure. Internal dependency aliases preserve Rust API names and point to versioned maintained packages; window backends share registry `dpi =0.1.2`. Existing source patches and their JADIX_PATCH/README explanations remain in this directory where applicable. Original copyright and license files are retained: LICENSE.

Package availability and ownership must be checked in the target registry; this provenance record identifies the maintained source.
